raw.content_en: CCPIT spokesperson statement on the USTR initiating a Section 301 investigation into forced labor and proposing additional tariffs. China exporters should treat this as a high-risk tariff and trade-remedy signal: monitor USTR Federal Register notices, docket comments, and proposed product lists; assess Section 301 exposure across affected HS lines; strengthen supply-chain traceability and labor-compliance documentation to rebut forced-labor allegations; and prepare contingency pricing, origin, and market-diversification plans. Coordinate with customs brokers and legal counsel on classification and duty mitigation.
raw.content_zh: 中国贸促会新闻发言人就美国贸易代表办公室发起强迫劳动301调查并拟加征关税发表谈话。中国出口企业应将其视为高风险关税与贸易救济信号：持续跟踪USTR联邦公报公告、评议程序及拟加征产品清单；评估受影响HS编码的301关税风险；完善供应链溯源与劳工合规文件以应对强迫劳动指控；提前制定应急定价、原产地及市场多元化方案，并与报关行及法律顾问协调归类与降税安排。

checklist.desc: Map your exported HS codes against USTR proposed tariff lists and Federal Register notices; flag any lines under investigation for forced-labor-linked duties.
Document tier-1 to tier-n suppliers, raw material origins, and labor recruitment records to rebut forced-labor allegations and support origin claims.
Compile audit reports, supplier codes of conduct, and recruitment-fee remediation records ready for CBP/USTR inquiries.
Verify country-of-origin determinations and customs valuation; prepare certificates and records supporting any duty mitigation or exclusion requests.
Model additional duty scenarios, update landed-cost and pricing models, and prepare contract clauses for tariff pass-through or renegotiation.
Identify alternative destination markets and re-routing options while ensuring compliance with anti-circumvention and rules-of-origin requirements.

raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and policy constraints on civilian firearms and related items under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and certain handguns should re-verify ECCN classification and license requirements under the restored framework, confirm US HTS alignment for customs filings, and re-screen customers and end users against BIS Entity List and restricted party lists. Section 301 tariff exposure and destination-country import controls (e.g., EU Firearms Directive, ASEAN import permits) still apply independently of the export control change.
raw.content_zh: 美国工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了《出口管理条例》下民用枪支及相关物项的许可与政策限制。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及部分手枪的企业应重新核实ECCN分类及恢复后框架下的许可要求，确认报关时美国HTS编码一致，并重新对客户和最终用户进行BIS实体清单及受限方名单筛查。第301条关税风险及目的国进口管制（如欧盟武器指令、东盟进口许可）仍独立于此次出口管制调整而适用。

checklist.desc: Re-classify firearms and parts under the rescinded rule framework; confirm whether a BIS license or license exception now applies and document the basis.

checklist.task: Entity List and restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all buyers, consignees, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists; retain screening records.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for each firearm model, check Section 301 list exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain non-transfer and end-use certificates from foreign consignees consistent with the restored civilian firearms policy.
Confirm destination-country firearms import permits and safety marking requirements (e.g., EU Firearms Directive, ASEAN national permits) before shipment.
